description: This source file contains the Composable UI components for the Task List screen in an Android app built with Jetpack Compose. It includes the main screen, task item views, and dialog for adding or editing tasks.

methods.name: TaskListScreen
methods.description: Main composable for displaying the list of tasks, handling error snackbar display, and showing dialogs for task addition/editing.

methods.name: EmptyState
methods.description: Displays a placeholder message when there are no tasks.

methods.name: formattedTime
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a human-readable date and time string.

methods.name: TaskItemView
methods.description: Displays a single task item with checkbox, title, description, last updated time, and edit/delete actions.

methods.name: AddEditTaskDialog
methods.description: Dialog component for adding a new task or editing an existing one with input validation.
